# `grow-jaeger` (crate `grow_jaeger`) — agent quickstart (Rust)

Ships inside the crate (`~/.cargo/registry/src/*/grow-jaeger-X.Y.Z/AGENTS.md`). Docs:
https://grow-codes-packages.github.io/jaeger/ · Service: Jaeger · Categories: tracing.

```sh
cargo add grow-jaeger && cargo add tokio --features macros,rt-multi-thread
```

## Client

```rust
let client = grow_jaeger::JaegerClient::new(grow_jaeger::JaegerConfig::from_env()?)?;
client.close().await;
```

Errors: `grow_jaeger::Error` with `code()` (`ErrorCode::NotFound`, …). Credentials are `Secret`.

## Tracing

The tracing entry point (`initTracing` / `InitTracing` / `init_tracing`) and its options are documented in the
package README and https://grow-codes-packages.github.io/jaeger/tracing/ (span helpers `withSpan`, `traced`,
`currentTraceId`, HTTP middleware).
